perspective:
Bradley Ochoa’s available information:

- He is Bradley Ochoa, a salesperson at the marketing firm. He knows Katherine Lasiloo as his colleague and the Marketing Manager. Their professional relationship is generally cordial but has had tension over differing sales vs. marketing strategies.
- He knows his own background as a Hispanic man with a high school education, and his own practical, traditional sales-oriented tendencies.
- In the meeting room, he prepared data and charts from the last five campaigns to support traditional sales methods. He heard Katherine acknowledge his point but argue that the market is evolving and digital outreach/online engagement cannot be ignored. She asked how he reconciled his data with increasing online engagement. He told her he was not suggesting abandoning digital marketing but felt proven traditional methods were being sidelined. Katherine said she understood and proposed analyzing the data together to integrate both approaches.
- After the meeting, Katherine shared recent digital campaign success stories that had boosted engagement and sales. He asked her to explain how those strategies are developed. She said it involves targeting the right audience with the right message and offered to walk him through the analytics and decision-making. He admitted he had doubted moving away from traditional methods but now wanted to understand digital better. She welcomed his openness and suggested diving deeper into the data.
- He proposed a joint strategy session to combine traditional and digital marketing. Katherine agreed and they planned to schedule a brainstorm to outline next steps. He expressed hope and appreciation; she said she looked forward to leveraging each other’s strengths.
- After the joint meeting, he felt excited and worked overtime on a board presentation draft integrating both their ideas. He showed it to Katherine. She praised it as comprehensive and well thought out. He said he was convinced the integrated approach would set them apart and wanted to nail the presentation. She agreed confidently and suggested fine-tuning.
- After the successful board presentation and implementation of the new strategy, he thanked Katherine, said he had learned and grown through their collaboration, and proposed regular strategy sessions. Katherine praised his openness and agreed. He felt grateful and wanted to continue the momentum.
- He experienced the joint meeting and presentation as successful, saw the integrated strategy implemented, and knew Katherine agreed to ongoing collaboration.
